exposure: Low municipal nurse density in public services
cohort: The study cohort consisted of over 5.6 million live births in 645 municipalities of Sao Paulo State, Brazil, between 2009 and 2018.
finding: The study developed an epidemiological risk score combining individual and municipal-level data in Brazil, demonstrating good predictive ability (AUC 0.83 internal, 0.81 external validation) for classifying neonatal death risk.
mod_finding: Preterm vaginal birth and preterm cesarean were assigned 4 points each, while term cesarean was assigned 1 point in the neonatal death risk score.
followup_time: Up to 28 days after birth (neonatal period)
gest_age: Mentioned as an exposure: preterm (implied <37 weeks)
